description.value: The Shepherd's Inn is a family-owned highway stop at Mile 72 of the Alaska Highway, about 42 km northwest of Fort St. John, serving home-cooked western and breakfast meals with bread, soups, and pies made from scratch on-site. It is part of a larger complex that includes a motel, convenience store, and fueling station — functioning as a genuine full-service oasis on a remote stretch of highway. Bus and RV tour groups are welcome with advance notice, and the restaurant takes to-go orders by phone.

address.value: 11890 Shepherds Inn Frontage Road, Charlie Lake, BC V1J 8L5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the restaurant is open year-round as part of a family-owned complex including a motel, convenience store, and fueling station at Mile 72 of the Alaska Highway.
